description:
Run the dashboard's replay-guarded same-item dependency re-arm.

    ``escalation_id`` is an ``expand_produced_nothing`` or
    ``roadmap_item_parked`` escalation id. Keelen verifies delivered structural
    prerequisites, grants one bounded
    expand retry, preserves the roadmap item id and ``depends_on_item_ids``, and
    resolves the matching cards in one transaction. A bounded live GitHub check
    may be used when the local merge state is stale, so a call can reach out
    even when the re-arm itself changes nothing.
name: rearm_roadmap_item
title: Rearm Roadmap Item
